extracted.intended_audience: LGBTQ+ students (age 13+), educators, school leaders, researchers, and advocates
extracted.subtask_description: A nonprofit research landing page summarizing GLSEN's topic areas and surveys used to document LGBTQ+ students' school experiences and inform policy and practice; solicits survey participation from LGBTQ+ youth age 13+.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant eligibility — LGBTQ+ students 13+ years old
rubrics_metrics.description: For LGBTQ+ students 13+ years old: We want to hear from you!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the target respondent population for GLSEN's surveys and research outreach (LGBTQ+ youth aged 13 and older).

rubrics_metrics.name: Impacts of GSAs
rubrics_metrics.description: Impacts of GSAs — GSAs save lives. Explore our findings on how they boost LGBTQ+ youth well-being and reduce harm in hostile school...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research focus on the presence/effects of Gay–Straight Alliances (GSAs) in schools as a lever to improve well‑being and reduce harm; implies evaluating GSA presence, participation, and associated student outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experiences of LGBTQ+ Families
rubrics_metrics.description: Experiences of LGBTQ+ Families — Youth with LGBTQ+ families bring a unique experience to navigating an educational environment. See what our research...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treats students from LGBTQ+ families as a distinct subgroup whose experiences in schools warrant separate study; implies collecting and analyzing family-structure–related variables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluating Inclusive Curriculum
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluating Inclusive Curriculum — Check out what our research says about curriculums inclusive of LGBTQ+ students, safer school climates, and improved educational outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on whether curricula that include LGBTQ+ content are associated with safer school climates and better educational outcomes; implies measuring curriculum inclusivity and related school climate/outcome metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Students of Color
rubrics_metrics.description: Students of Color — See how race, culture, and identity shape school life for LGBTQ+ youth of color, and how educators and administrators can make a difference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes intersectional analysis of race/ethnicity with LGBTQ+ identity; implies disaggregating data by race/culture to evaluate differing school experiences and needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Addressing Harassment and Discrimination
rubrics_metrics.description: Addressing Harassment and Discrimination — Find out how we’re supporting the alarming number of LGBTQ+ youth across the country who report facing harassment and discrimination at school.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research area focused on prevalence, forms, and consequences of harassment/discrimination and designing/supporting interventions and policies to reduce them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understanding Gender Identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Understanding Gender Identity — Hear directly from trans, nonbinary, gender nonconforming and two-spirit youth about their experience in school, and...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Centers qualitative and quantitative data collection from trans, nonbinary, gender-nonconforming, and Two-Spirit youth to document specific experiences and needs related to gender identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Athletics
rubrics_metrics.description: Athletics — Misinformation about trans athletes harms students and schools alike. Glisten research sheds light on LGBTQ+...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research focus on athletics policy and discourse, particularly how misinformation about trans athletes affects student well‑being and school climates; implies evaluating policy impacts and media/messaging effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supportive Educators & Leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Supportive Educators & Leaders — Strong data empowers strong leadership. See how Glisten’s research helps educators create affirming classrooms for...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes research to inform educator and administrator practices; implies measuring educator behaviors, school leadership support, and links to student outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: National School Climate Surveys
rubrics_metrics.description: National School Climate Surveys — Glisten’s School Climate Survey asks LGBTQ+ youth across the country to share their experiences in schools and...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes GLSEN's large-scale survey instrument and approach for capturing nationwide data on LGBTQ+ students' school experiences; implies standards for survey scope, sampling, and national representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Data Inclusion — Better data drives change. See how Glisten collects more robust data on LGBTQ+ youth and uses it to guide the...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commits to more robust, inclusive data practices (e.g., inclusive demographic measures, disaggregation) to better represent LGBTQ+ youth and inform policy; implies criteria for data completeness and inclusivity.
